title: Illness
description: Acute illness and injury, and what care costs (M2.7 step 2, D104, D105): each kind's yearly rate, how long it lasts, whether it keeps you from work, and what it takes from your health; a doctor's visit, a hospital stay and their prices with and without Medicaid; and the income below which Medicaid covers you. The figures trace to CALIBRATION.md.

kinds.description: The illnesses and injuries, each caught at its rate a day.

perYear.description: Cases a year per 100 adults; for a work injury, per 100 full-time workers, caught only on a shift.

off.description: Of those, the first days it keeps you from work.

health.description: Health it takes a day while it lasts.

visit.description: Days a doctor's visit takes off it.
A doctor's visit: its price, in cents, by coverage, and the hours it takes.

employer.description: The copay on an employer's plan (M2.7 step 5).

hospital.description: A stay in hospital when health reaches nothing: the days, and the price a day, in cents, by coverage; health is given back by the day.

employer.description: What an employer's plan leaves you to pay a day.

medicaid.description: The Healthy Michigan Plan: monthly gross income below the line for a household of one, and the line's rise for each more person, in cents.

hours.description: Hours a month a wage is counted at.
